title: rosa gallica var. subtomentella
intro: Rosa gallica var. subtomentella, commonly known as the French rose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The French rose is known for its fragrant and delicate flowers, which have been used for centuries in perfumes, teas, and traditional medicine. This plant is rich in antioxidants and has been associated with various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica var. subtomentella are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-histaminic activities.
